SC-46.name: Compliance overview (MVP-A home)
notes: Each card opens the report at that figure (SC-10).
States: empty (no data → 'Upload an export to begin' with link to SC-24), computing (progress), outdated snapshot (badge, figures unchanged).
Responsive: cards wrap 2 per row below 900 px; chart above data status.

SC-24.name: Data imports
notes: Primary action changes with the batch state: Upload → View report → Open mapping → Load.
States: validating (job progress), rejected (banner + row report download), superseded (greyed row, still readable).
A re-import of a loaded period supersedes the earlier batch (BR-IMP-04).

SC-25.name: Import mapping
notes: Approve is available to the compliance officer only; the consultant can save drafts.
Validation: every value mapped or explicitly left unknown.

SC-10.name: Compliance reports
notes: Every figure and table cell is a link to its drill-down (SC-26).
The method panel is always visible beside the figures.
States: snapshot outdated (badge), partial year for R5 (labelled, not publishable), denominator zero (figure shows '—' with reason).

SC-26.name: Figure drill-down
notes: Sums of row sets must equal the figure's components (AC-41.1).
Export above the role cap is refused with a path to a scheduled export.

SC-27.name: Sign in
notes: Generic error messages; lockout after repeated failures (AC-35.2).
Tenant resolved from the hostname; no tenant picker.
mnotes: Distributor sign-in: one-time code by default; numeric keyboard for the code; generic error text.

SC-28.name: Users and roles
notes: Role editor shows the permission matrix; conflicting duty pairs are refused with an explanation.
The sole remaining admin cannot remove their own admin role.

SC-14.name: Vendor access sessions
notes: The second table is the per-session log, visible to the tenant.
States: pending, active (countdown + End now), expired, denied, auto-denied (no decision).

SC-39.name: Vendor operations console
notes: No route leads to participant, order or payout data.
An approved session opens the tenant's staff application in a marked read-only frame with a countdown.

SC-01.name: Periods and runs
notes: The only primary button is the next valid action for the newest unfinished period.
States: empty (no periods → connect store or import history), running (stages, safe to leave), failed (diagnostics + Resume), locked (committed: lock icon, 'Request restatement').
Responsive (≥1024 px): table scrolls horizontally inside its container; state timeline wraps.

SC-02.name: Run review
notes: Commit opens a critical-approval dialog: totals, variance, exceptions acknowledged one by one, step-up authentication.
States: stale sync after run (banner, commit blocked), superseded by a newer run (read-only), permission-limited (preparer sees commit disabled with reason).

SC-32.name: Late-transaction queue
notes: Bulk accept shows a preview: count, total effect, affected payees.
Items whose bonus policy is 'restatement' propose a restatement request instead.

SC-04.name: Plan versions
notes: Diff view shows changed rules side by side in plain language.
States: guardrail blocked (save refused with rule id), activation blocked (no simulation, failing golden case, missing filing), immutable (approved or active: read-only).

SC-05.name: Cap configuration
notes: Changing the method re-computes the preview so the difference between proportional and priority is visible before saving.
Validation: priority list must cover the scope; residue rule required.

SC-42.name: Simulation results
notes: Totals reconcile to each run (AC-10.1).
A failing golden case lists the failing lines and blocks submission.

SC-44.name: Plan change workflow
notes: Each check row explains what is missing; a blocked step cannot be skipped.
Filing row appears only where the market pack requires a filing.

SC-07.name: Genealogy explorer
notes: Never renders a whole tree: focused node, breadcrumb, first level, lazy expansion, counts on collapsed branches.
States: read model rebuilding (notice; depth-limited view from the system of record).
Keyboard: arrow keys move, right expands, left collapses; an indented-list alternative is always available.

SC-08.name: Genealogy change request
notes: Change = effective from a date onward; correction = from the original date, listing affected committed periods.
Errors: outside window, would create a cycle, target slot taken.
The duplicate-case variant shows two records side by side with matching attributes highlighted.

SC-09.name: Participant record
notes: Sensitive fields are masked; 'Show' is a separate audited action with step-up.
All history tabs are read-only tables of effective-dated rows.

SC-06.name: Case: manual adjustment
notes: The same case layout serves disputes (trace attached automatically) and restatements (diff per payee and bonus).
States: approval pending, rejected (reason), blocked by policy (escalation path).

SC-03.name: Payout batch
notes: After approval the Instructions tab shows per-line state: instructed, accepted, settled, returned, failed; 'Retry failed lines' only.
States: balance changed since draft (affected line recalculated, batch back to Draft), provider not eligible (blocked).

SC-33.name: Ledger
notes: Every row links to its origin (run, batch, case).
No edit or delete control exists anywhere on this screen.
Export blocked with a list when an account has no mapping to the tenant's chart of accounts.

SC-13.name: Integrations and sync health
notes: API key creation shows the key once; only a hash is stored.
Payout connections show the provider approval evidence and date (FR-PAY-006).

SC-16.name: Migration and parallel run
notes: Import validation blocks on cycles, orphans and balance mismatches.
Each difference is classified and either fixed or explained and approved.

SC-17.name: Market launch checklist
notes: Each row opens an evidence uploader.
Blocked items are named in the go-live refusal.

SC-35.name: Executive overview
notes: Every figure has an (i) popover with its definition and links to its source.
Partial-data banner when sync is behind.
No income projection or recruit count appears.

SC-47.name: Licence, updates and diagnostics (self-hosted)
notes: Diagnostics: job queues, outbox age, replication, last backup, last restore test, time sync.
The support bundle shows a redaction summary before export.

SC-37.name: Distributor home
notes: No targets, projections or recruit counts.
States: no committed period yet (explains when the first statement appears), payout held (reason and end date).
mnotes: One column; primary action in thumb reach; at most five bottom-navigation items.
Offline: last loaded content with its time.

SC-18.name: Statement
notes: Net = gross − withholding − clawback ± adjustment, always shown as lines.
Committed periods only; an open period shows status, never an estimate.
No other person's personal data in explanations.
mnotes: Tapping a line opens the explanation as a bottom sheet.
Net first; withholding and clawbacks as separate labelled lines.

SC-19.name: Rank status
notes: States: grace period active (explained with end period), plan change in progress (transition notice).
mnotes: Facts only: requirements and measured values. No 'earn up to', no next-rank prompts.

SC-20.name: Team
notes: Outside your own downline nothing is returned, identical to 'not found'.
mnotes: List drill-in instead of a drawn tree on phones.
The API returns only permitted fields; nothing is hidden client-side.

SC-21.name: My customers
notes: Contact fields appear only if the tenant's policy allows.
mnotes: Table becomes a card list with the three most important fields.

SC-22.name: Payment details and tax profile
notes: The cooling-off length is a tenant setting; the screen shows the actual date.
States: cooling-off active, change refused (re-authentication failed), under review (shared-account signal).
mnotes: One question group per screen; numeric keyboard for account number; re-authentication first.

SC-41.name: Public privacy request
notes: Confirmation page shows a reference number only.
mnotes: Rate limited and bot-protected; the response never confirms whether a person exists.
